Subject: Dedicated commit proposal — credit & throughput questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the term sheet. Quick clarifying questions from procurement before we loop legal:

- Sentinel is comfortable with the 24-month reserved commit, but we need a firm throughput SLO for steady-state (our inference peak is seasonal). Can Redwood guarantee 200 qps sustained per 8-GPU pool with <120ms p50 for 512-token requests?
- Procurement is asking for an operational credit: if we miss the throughput SLO two months in a row, can we receive a service credit equal to 5% of that month’s committed fees?
- On discounts: we expected a larger entry credit based on competitor offers (they proposed a first-year credit covering ~20% of committed spend). Is there flexibility for an up-front API credit rather than a retroactive rebate?

I can take a call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Thanks,
Emily

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Dedicated commit proposal — credit & throughput questions

Looping in Vivek for executive credit signoff guidance.

Marcus — assuming Sentinel runs a mix of Llama2-weighted 70B quantized and a smaller 13B fine-tuned family, what’s realistic on the 8-GPU SKU for sustained 200 qps at ~512 tokens? We may need to propose either 2x 8-GPU pools or a single 16-GPU configuration to meet p50 targets consistently.

On credits — Sentinel is asking for an up-front API credit around 18–20% of year-1 committed spend. That’s higher than our standard promotional tiers for mid-market, but this is a strategic competitor-match ask. If we do an up-front credit, finance will want that amortized against the commit over 24 months in the contract.

Proposed internal options:
- Option A (conservative): 10% up-front credit + SLA operational credit (5% monthly on SLA breach), require a 24-month commit and minimum 8-GPU*2 pool.
- Option B (aggressive): 18% up-front credit (one-time), include a step-down price floor in year 2, and stronger SLA credits (7% monthly cap) — requires exec signoff (Vivek).

Vivek — need quick thumbs: can we approve Option B for strategic accounts if Legal agrees to amortization language and we get an LOE commitment from their infra team for migration?

—Marissa

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Dedicated commit proposal — credit & throughput questions

Thanks team. High level: Sentinel looks strategic and the competitive landscape is real — I’d be comfortable approving Option B conditionally. Conditions:

1) Legal must accept amortization schedule and a clawback if they materially underutilize (<65% utilization averaged over first 6 months).
2) We require an initial validation run (2-week performance validation) on their representative workload before go-live; if they fail validation, commit still applies but credits reduced to Option A levels.
3) Limit total upfront credit exposure to a not-to-exceed $1.2M cash-equivalent on our books for this ARR band.

If Legal and Finance are aligned on the amortization/clawback language, we can proceed with Option B. Please prepare a short exec summary for formal sign-off.

Vivek
Chief Commercial Officer, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@sentinel.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@sentinel.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Sentinel — revised offer and approval path

Hi Emily / Rajiv,

Thanks for the patience while we coordinated internally. Based on the details you provided and our competitive review, here’s a revised, actionable offer:

- Commitment: 24 months, reserved 16-GPU equivalent capacity (can be delivered as two 8-GPU pools or a single 16-GPU pool — architectural choice is yours).
- Throughput SLO: 200 qps sustained at 512 tokens p50 <= 120ms for the validated model family (validation required — see below).
- Credits/discounts: 18% of year-1 committed spend as an up-front API credit applied at contract execution. Per Vivek’s guidance we’ll amortize that credit over 24 months in financial schedules; legal will include a clawback if average utilization <65% in months 1–6. Not-to-exceed exposure: $1.2M.
- SLA operational credit: if throughput SLO missed in two consecutive months, Sentinel will receive a 5% service credit for the impacted month (we can cap cumulative credits to 12% annually).
- Validation: 2-week performance validation on Sentinel test corpus prior to production turn-up. If validation fails, credits reduce to Option A levels (10% up-front credit + 5% SLA credit) per our fallback.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, I’ll ask Legal to issue a redline-ready term sheet with the amortization/clawback language and attach the SOW (sentinel_sow_v2.docx).
2) I’ll also get Marcus to schedule a 2-week validation window and provide an initial runbook for the test (expected start within 7 business days of LOI).

Can you confirm by end-of-day Thursday whether Sentinel accepts the conditional Option B path so we can route to Legal and Finance? Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk the terms.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
